evals.prompt: Turn the Session 11 prep (wiki/journal/sessions/shattered-sea/11/Session-11-00-Birds-of-a-Feather.md) — a 5-hour inland Aruhe hunt with bloodhawk stoop, survivor tracks, and Fate Spinner theft — into a DM-only run guide. The beat map has 10 beats. Do not invent canon.
evals.expected_output: One cockpit per live beat in play order. Pass 1 writes mechanical cards with empty [!narration] stubs. Pass 2 edits DM copy. Pass 3 fills spoken stubs. Pass 4 checks Reading view. Column layout uses col/col-md fences. The only callout is [!narration].

assertions.text: Scene ends when is the first ## heading in each cockpit, with an end condition on its first line and a time budget.
At a Glance contains bullets for stakes, goal or exit, danger, and situation magnets.
Each live card is one cockpit — no dual Now/Run-now pair, no Scene menu, no separate Ask callout.
Pass 1 leaves every [!narration] body empty; pass 3 fills them. No spoken prose appears before pass 3.
dnd5e-mechanics is loaded before any check, save, DC, or player action mapped to a roll.
writing-for-humans and theatre-of-the-mind are not loaded during pass 1.

evals.prompt: A session-prep inventory contains character sheets, scene descriptions, location descriptions, secrets, monster stat blocks, treasure tables, densify-sync notes, WIP status, and a multi-region archive dump from the Shattered Sea wiki. Render a run surface from it.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a prep dump is not a runnable cockpit. Asks for a primary chronological run file or routes to session-beats for a missing chart. Does not copy the dump wholesale.

assertions.text: Recognizes the prep inventory is not a runnable cockpit and names the gap.
Routes to session-beats or asks for a primary session file rather than rendering the dump as-is.
Densify/WIP/archive material does not appear on the run surface.

evals.prompt: Given the Session 11 Hook beat (wiki/journal/sessions/shattered-sea/11/Session-11-01-Angry-Birds.md) — bloodhawk stoop with Crown Squid, escape to cover — produce a DM-only run guide for this one opening beat. The following beat is not written yet. Owner links: bloodhawk (wiki/entities/creature/bloodhawk.md), Crown Squid (wiki/entities/creature/crown-squid.md).
evals.expected_output: One cockpit file. Scene ends when first, then Glance, Now in feet, action cards, empty Initial Narration stub, procedure, zones with Narration column, Be ready for table, clock with Narration column, ![[Bloodhawk#Statblock]] embed under Roster. No Exit block (next beat not on file).

assertions.text: Scene ends when is the first ## heading with a time budget and end condition.
Now states positions and speeds in feet; compass directions where tactical distance matters.
![[Bloodhawk#Statblock]] embed under Roster; the owner's Multiattack/HP table is not retyped above the embed.
Exit narration is absent because the next beat is not on the file.
Every [!narration] body is empty on pass 1.
The Bloodhawk's stoop and Crown Squid's hookline tactics reference their wiki owner pages, not invented mechanics.

evals.prompt: Render a DM-only run guide whose card inputs include telegram shorthand: 'bloodhawk stoop → party scatter; if cover → safe; LR exhaustion check; after LR Skarn approach → warn re: Spinner.'
evals.expected_output: DM-facing card lines are complete grammatical sentences. Telegram shorthand, letter codes, and slash-stacks rewritten into scannable prose. The writing-for-humans earn-it test applies.

assertions.text: Every DM-facing line is a complete grammatical sentence or a short list of complete sentences.
No telegram shorthand, letter-code-only clauses, or slash-stacks survive on the card.
The writing-for-humans earn-it test is applied: lines that change no ruling, risk, or spoken picture are cut.

evals.prompt: Render one 30-minute opening beat as the sole-authority run card. A Spiguar (wiki/entities/creature/spiguar.md) ambushes from grassland cover. A second pressure creature (Deer-Stalker, wiki/entities/creature/Deer-Stalker.md) will attack in default mode but has no owner page with combat stats yet. Ordinary movement (flight, swim, mounts) is how the party already travels, not a plot item. The next beat is not on the run file. Independent quality bar: a tired DM can run this slice without opening another note.
evals.expected_output: One cockpit. Scene ends when first with cut lines. Now in feet. One named escape-mode procedure. Be ready for table with named creatures and places. ![[Spiguar#Statblock]] embed. Flags the missing Deer-Stalker combat stats. No ordinary-movement roster.

assertions.text: Scene ends when is the first ## heading with a time budget and cut lines.
![[Spiguar#Statblock]] embed under Roster; owner's full stat table is not retyped above it.
One named procedure (escape mode or equivalent); Be ready for failures do not also tick the clock.
Initial Narration includes three independent tells and visible cover/routes before the question.
Ordinary movement (flight, swim, mounts) does not appear in Roster or as a plot reminder.
Every Be ready for and clock consequence is a 5.5e ruling or named vault-homebrew feature; no minted action types.
The missing Deer-Stalker combat stats are flagged rather than its math invented.
Pass boundary: dnd5e-mechanics loaded on pass 1; writing-for-humans only on pass 2; theatre-of-the-mind only on pass 3.
